ai_summary: Ashoka Buildcon Limited reported largely stable Q1 FY2027 standalone financial results, experiencing a slight revenue decline but an improved net profit. Concurrently, the Board re-designated two Whole-time Directors as Joint Managing Directors, signaling a leadership restructure. A material red flag is present as auditors highlighted an ongoing sub-judice regulatory matter involving the company, for which no financial adjustments have been made pending its final outcome, posing potential future impacts.
